player_prompt.intro:
You will observe {N} hidden values sequentially.
At each step type [accept] to pick the *current* value, or [continue] to skip it and see the next one.
If you never accept, you are forced to take the final value.
You win (reward = 1) **only** if the value you ultimately pick is the highest of all.

game_action.current_value: Kä ye kek yök në yemɛɛn ee {value}.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛmken ë bëër kekë ye cɔl ëbɛn [accept] kɛn ëbɛn [continue].

outcome.summary: Yin aci ë bɛn {value} kɛn draw {draw_num}/{N}. Ë bɛn de luel ëbɛn {best}. {result}
outcome.perfect: Kë cï kuany ee path apɛi!
